problem_solved: After autonomous-cycle exits 0, continuation-signal.json points to advisory next-sprint.md (product Markdown). The orchestrator continuation_router.py rejects advisory paths. Without evidence_continuation.py, the system stops.
solution: evidence_continuation.py detects advisory signals and generates machine-readable next-action.json + updates active-continuation.json to point to it.
new_flow: autonomous-cycle -> continuation-signal.json -> evidence_continuation.py detects advisory -> generates next-action.json -> active-continuation.json -> orchestrator CONTINUES
